goal: Rebuild trust with a lead that stalled, then get a Live Q&A registration. If they finish without registering, move them to monthly nurture.
name: Reactivation

goal: Get someone who registered for a Live Q&A to show up. Set the session time to the start of that Live Q&A.
name: Attendance reminders

goal: Bring back someone who registered and missed the Live Q&A. Do not send the replay to the general list.
name: No-show follow-up

goal: Book the Ask Anything 1:1 while the Live Q&A is still fresh. The day-of email is the existing invite. The day-2 text is the existing invite text, sent only if the call is not answered.
name: Attendee follow-up

goal: Get someone who booked an Ask Anything 1:1 to show up. Set the session time to the start of that conversation.
name: Ask Anything 1:1 reminders

goal: Rebook the Ask Anything 1:1 after a missed conversation. If this finishes without a booking, move them to monthly nurture.
name: Missed Ask Anything 1:1

goal: Book the in-home visit for someone who wants to think about it. Every touch comes from the guide who ran the conversation. The day-4 text is the existing home-visit text, sent only if the call is not answered.
name: After an Ask Anything 1:1

goal: One email a month. The cycle is no ask, no ask, then a soft ask, and then it repeats. A hard ask goes out about every third month.
name: Monthly nurture, not yet at a Live Q&A

goal: One email a month for someone who registered or attended. The cycle is no ask, soft ask, hard ask, and then it repeats.
name: Monthly nurture, after a Live Q&A

goal: One email a month. The cycle is a soft ask, then a hard ask for the visit, and then it repeats. These homeowners do not go inactive on their own.
name: Monthly nurture, after an Ask Anything 1:1

goal: Sent around the holidays in addition to the regular cadence. Skip that person's nearest regular email that week.
name: Seasonal emails
